class.name: OcgBrepmeshGeomtool
class.brief_description: Tool class accumulating common geometrical functions as well as functionality using shape geometry to produce data necessary for tessellation. General aim is to calculate discretization points for the given curve or iso curve of surface according to the specified parameters.
